rat_burrow.subject: A large mound of packed brown earth with a dark round tunnel mouth framed by three weathered wooden planks. Five grey rats with pink ears, pink tails and small red eyes leave the tunnel, spaced well apart, each in a different pose: one running ahead toward the lower right, one sniffing the air, one turning its head back, one climbing over a clod of dirt, and one stepping out of the dark opening. A little dust trails behind them.
